description: Selects a node of the current Inspector snapshot in the dashboard (it is highlighted for the user, marked as the AI's pick), by nodeId from inspect_screen or get_inspector_selection; null clears the selection. Pass snapshotId to make sure the dashboard still shows the snapshot you looked at. Returns the selected node's label. get_inspector_selection then returns only the structure of a node you selected (no text, content description or image).

nodeId.description: Node id of the current snapshot; null clears the selection.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the node id belongs to.

name: select_inspector_node
title: Select an Inspector node
